column1: # What a comparison returns. Registering this kind is what turns
# `1000 МБ = 1 ГБ` from an unresolvable expression into `true`.
# `true` and `false` are not translated, and that is this file's finding
# rather than an oversight it hides: the kind ships no vocabulary at all,
# so `formatValue` degrades to the unit key in every language. A Russian
# engine answering "true" is what the code does today, and a row asserting
# it is what makes a later `boolean/locale/ru` a visible diff here.
# The four plural categories, read rather than written. 21 takes the
# singular and 11 does not, which is the rule the teens carve out.
# The fractional category is the genitive singular — and where Polish and
# Russian part company on the same number: `few` is the nominative plural
# there ("2 metry") and the genitive singular here ("2 метра").
# The feminine unit, whose nominative plural and genitive singular coincide.
# Both word operators are two tokens hanging off "на", which is `keywords.by`
# rather than an operator of its own.
